notes.title: Game update!
notes.content:
Hello everybody.
We have another update. At this time we have added logic elements.
Now you can create logic chicks.

Also for those who like to arrange a marble race, we have added the names of the balls and the finish for the balls. When the ball hits the finish line, the screen displays the time taken by the ball to complete the track.

notes.title: Steam Workshop
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32131790/54c006a2c61de9e0844973de88911439e4659c75.png[/img]
Good news for all Marble Run lovers. We launched a workshop Steam. Now, any user of the game will be able to upload his building to the workshop. And see the buildings of other users.
